# Dictionary.com

> > Dictionary.com is a comprehensive online dictionary and thesaurus platform offering word definitions, language resources, mobile apps for iPhone and Android, and daily word games.

Dictionary.com provides lexicography services including word definitions, synonyms, language learning tools, and interactive word puzzles. The platform features Word of the Day subscriptions, daily games powered by Arkadium, and multilingual content including Spanish-language games.

## Key Topics

- Dictionary.com
- Lexicography
- Word definitions and thesaurus
- Mobile apps (iPhone and Android)
- Word of the Day
- Word games and puzzles
- Crosswords and sudoku
- Email subscriptions
- Arkadium games
- Spanish language resources (juegos diarios)
- Daily word puzzles
- Free online games
- Language learning tools

## Help & Support

- [Dictionary.com Help Center](https://help.dictionary.com/): Help center for Dictionary.com and Thesaurus.com user support and FAQs

## Optional

- [Juegos Diarios en línea gratis | De Dictionary.com](https://play.dictionary.com/es/categoría/diario): Spanish daily games page featuring crosswords, sudoku, and word puzzles
